spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    chiller_id as "chillerId",
    FLOOR((
        total_runtime_seconds
        + COALESCE(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - current_started_at)))::bigint, 0)
    ) / 3600.0) AS total_run_time_hours
FROM chiller_runtime
WHERE chiller_id = '${chiller}';

spec.query:
from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "compressor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["chillerId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "actualRpm" or r["_field"] == "current")
  |> mean()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.current > 0.01)
  |> group()
  |> mean(column: "actualRpm")  
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with perc: r.actualRpm / 5200.0 }))

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "compressor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["chillerId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "suctionPressure" or r["_field"] == "dischargePressure" or r["_field"] == "current")
  |> mean()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.current > 0.01)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with lift: r.dischargePressure - r.suctionPressure}))
  |> group()
  |> mean(column: "lift")

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "compressor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["chillerId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "percentRla")
  |> group()
  |> mean()

spec.query:
from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "run")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chiller1")
  |> integral(unit: 1s)

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["chillerId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "compressor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "${chiller}${comps}")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey:[], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

data = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["chillerId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "compressor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "percentRla")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

avg = data
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "deviceId", value: "average")

union(tables: [data, avg])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "deviceId", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["deviceId"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

maxData = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] != "localRemote")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

minData = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "localRemote")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)

union(tables: [minData, maxData])
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value", "_time"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "water")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "chiller" or r["_measurement"] == "water")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey:[], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with loadPerc: r.actualCapacity / float(v: ${chillerCapacity}), chillerId: "${chiller}"}))
